title: Kagamine Len — Always The Best Partners〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Miku said she'd be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aha...!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There you are, MEIKO! I finally found you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Len.
Were you looking for me just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup.
I wanted to ask you about that fragment.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Remember how we got separated after being sent over to that SEKAI together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can you tell me more about where you went after we got split up?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, can you tell me about what happened on your end as well?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, while I was witnessing how Akito and Toya first met, you were with An the whole time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. She practiced and performed in events all by herself, while looking very hard for someone she could call her partner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But that must've been really hard.
I mean, she didn't meet Kohane until high school, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which means... She kept searching for over two years?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only did she struggle to find a good partner, she had to deal with a lot of naysayers.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Naysayers?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That fragment only allowed me to catch glimpses of what happened up until she met Kohane...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I was able to see how people's thoughts regarding RAD WEEKEND changed on Vivid Street as more and more time progressed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Immediately following it, a lot of people wanted to put on an event that would surpass it. But it would soon turn into “that legendary night”, which nobody would ever surpass.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As the competition increased, and as people began to try harder and harder, both the performers and their audience slowly began coming to terms with a harsh reality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Putting on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND would be impossibly difficult.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right...
So, everyone around her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As more and more began to revere RAD WEEKEND as “that legendary night”, the number of people hoping to surpass it dwindled significantly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Trying to find a partner who'd allow her to surpass that night must've been so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, very hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But hard work and dedication ultimately pays off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because she found the best partner she could've asked for in Kohane!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This sort of applies to everyone in all the other SEKAI too, but fate, it seems, has a strange sense of humor...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, Len, do you know the story behind how Kohane and An met?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... Kohane got lost on her way back from the store, stumbled upon a cafe where she happened to hear someone singing and decided to go in, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, imagine if her mother hadn't asked her to go out and buy that CD...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or if she hadn't gotten lost after taking that back alley.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And what if An wasn't singing there?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, this is An we're talking about...
She was basically singing every day, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. True.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, what are the odds?
Do you think their feelings had anything to do with them meeting?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, what if their feelings made Kohane's mom ask her to go buy that CD...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really can't say...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that sense, them meeting could be considered a miracle.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or Nagi slowly nudged them closer and closer together as she watched them from up above.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Their next goal is to stand on top of the world, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they really do like to dream big, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I bet they'll succeed!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I'll be rooting for you guys from SEKAI, so go show the world what you've got!)
